Company overview

Company name
Mega Insurance
Industry
Health insurance, general insurer
Use case
Health claims review
Customer
Mega Insurance

About the company. Mega Insurance is a general insurer. Its health claims team works with enterlabs on claims review.

A growing claims volume for a small review team

A growing volume of health claims, mostly outpatient, was reviewed by a small team on the previous claims system.

What we built

Every claim is read, checked against the policy and tariffs, and flagged for medical relevance. The insurer's analysts approve each decision.

  1. 1Read each claim

    Every claim is read so the billed items can be reviewed in full.

  2. 2Check against the policy and tariffs

    Each claim is checked against the policy and tariffs.

  3. 3Flag for medical relevance

    Claims are flagged for medical relevance.

  4. 4Analysts approve each decision

    The insurer's analysts approve each decision.
